title: Calculated field without comment
description:
Documentation rule — calculated fields with an empty field comment. The formula is often non-obvious and deserves a note.

Based on the PMD rule CommentRequired — https://docs.pmd-code.org/latest/pmd_rules_java_documentation.html#commentrequired A filter switch above the table toggles between items without and with a comment (the commented ones serve as documentation inspiration).
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: Undocumented calculations hide business rules that only the formula encodes.
rule.remediation: Add a field comment summarising what the calculation returns and why.
